title: Fold a design into a box
summary: Put a picture on a flat box template, fold it into 3D, spin it and open the lid.
brief: A browser tool for packaging mockups: choose a box shape and size, put a picture on the flat template with its cut and fold lines, then fold it into a 3D box you can spin and open.

assets.excerpt: 6.95–9.55 s of the post video, cropped to 16:9
Frame at 8.6 s of the post video, cropped to 16:9

prompts.text: Build a small web tool that folds a flat box template into a 3D box. Show a flat dieline for a lidded carton, with solid cut lines and dashed fold lines, and a sample image applied to its faces. Add a button that folds the dieline into a 3D box with an animated fold. In 3D, drag to rotate, click to open and close the lid, and scroll to zoom. Add a shape picker with six simple box shapes (carton, tuck box, pyramid, gift bag, tall box, flat mailer), width/depth/height fields, and an upload button that puts any picture you choose onto the box. Keep the page clean: white background, one 3D stage, one side panel, no extra titles. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when done, check that it works, and ask before installing or loading anything.
prompts.label: Make a box folding tool

action.label: Make a foldable 3D box in Atu
